change: Consistent icons in overflow menu actions
behavior: Terminal, tab, session and server overflow actions use shared 19 dp outline glyphs. Theme toggle shows the sun/moon for the target appearance. Material leading-icon colors supply disabled-state dimming; destructive session closing retains its error color. Decorative icons add no redundant accessibility labels. Existing callbacks, action availability, labels and pane-creation behavior remain unchanged.
test_notes: Existing quick-theme toggle, session-rename menu and tab hold/reorder-menu checks passed. No new tests were added for this cosmetic change. Actual MainActivity overflow menu was captured and inspected in light/dark modes on a reset disposable emulator, including disabled actions. No live user terminal was touched. Pane split selection is a UI proposal only in this release.
